title: Region detail: a serif name over a hairline, a serif rank over a 31-cell strip, a serif index over a bar with an expected mark, tabs and a six-row list, and a treemap of pastel tiles
use: The detail of one region (or one sector): rank among 31, index value and the breakdown of its attention. rank and index are parameters; the numerals, the strip, the bar and the shares (from seed) agree.

theme.note: light (ivory #FAF9F5) or dark (#141413) ground; tile names and the tooltip keep their fixed inks

list_title.default: 广东最常被关注的板块。

tree_hint.default: 面积为关注占比，颜色对应左侧列表

tree_note.default: 关注占比之和因隐私过滤不到 100%。示例数据。

relations: The left column is 704 wide: a serif 64 name over a hairline, a serif 52 numeral beside a 31-cell strip (14 x 36 cells on a 2 gap, the region's cell blue), an index bar 36 high scaled 0-6 with a 1.5 ink mark at 1.0, serif 22 tabs (the first underlined) and six 52-high rows.
The treemap fills a 576 x 610 area of the right panel, squarified, each tile 1 unit inset; its colours are the list's dots in the same order.
decoration: The strip, bar, mark, dots, panel and treemap tiles are decoration; row numbers are real text.

provenance.corpus: market hotspot index explorer kit (examples/index-explorer-kit): our own original data page in the index-explorer grammar; every number is generated in the page and marked as sample data
provenance.experiment: styles/index-explorer/style.json provenance (two public reference pages measured privately in Chrome on 2026-11-21; never shipped)
provenance.method: The data page's state and country detail re-set: rank strip, index bar with its expected mark, tabs, ranked list, treemap.
measured: Name serif 48 / 57.6; numerals serif 32 / 38.4; strip cells 10 x 24 on a 1 px gap in rgba(188,209,202,.75), the region's cell #6A9BCC; index bar 24 high; tabs serif 18 / 500 with a 2 px underline; ten ranked rows; a treemap of pastel tiles.
Template: every rank 1-31 and index 0.1-6 pass; the treemap never leaves its panel.
